articles.author: Lucas GC Ltd
articles.headline: Lucas GC reports effectiveness of share capital restructuring and amended articles
articles.summary: The Form 6-K reports completion of a shareholder-approved capital restructuring and amended articles, with Nasdaq reflection expected October 7. Authorized share capital changes are not represented as already issued shares. The October 2 meeting is an event date, distinct from this October 6 filing.

articles.author: Lucas GC Ltd
articles.headline: Lucas GC Limited Announces 1H 2026 Financial Results: Revenue at US$35.74 million with Increases in Gross Margin
articles.summary: Lucas reports first-half revenue of approximately $35.7 million, down 36.6% year over year, while gross margin rises to 35.4%. Management describes a shift toward higher-margin technology services. Margin improvement is distinct from revenue growth.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original GlobeNewswire header explicitly gives October 7, 2026 09:00 ET.
